title: Senior / Systems Engineer (Battery & Energy Storage Systems)
desc:
Senior / Systems Engineer – Battery & Energy Storage Systems
As
Altınay Savunma Teknolojileri
, we are looking for a
Senior / Systems Engineer
to join our Battery and Energy Storage Systems (BESS/ESS) projects developed for the defense industry.
In this role, you will play an active part throughout the entire product lifecycle, from
concept design and system integration to testing and validation, mass production, field commissioning, and product lifecycle management
.
Responsibilities
Analyze requirements and develop system requirements for battery and energy storage systems designed for
land, naval, aerial, and unmanned platforms
.
Ensure traceability of system and subsystem requirements.
Contribute to the design, integration, testing, and validation processes of
BMS, high-/low-voltage power distribution systems, and thermal management systems
.
Conduct testing, commissioning, and platform integration activities in both laboratory and field environments.
Support the resolution of technical issues encountered during mass production processes.
Contribute to the preparation of production and assembly instructions and apply
Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
principles.
Conduct
ECR/ECO, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and technical sustainability
activities throughout the product lifecycle.
Prepare and execute test plans in accordance with
MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461
, and relevant battery safety and validation standards.
Work collaboratively with
Mechanical, Electronics, Software, Quality, and Production
teams.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in
Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control & Automation Engineering, Systems Engineering
, or a related field.
At least
3 years of experience
in battery systems, Li-ion cell technologies, BMS, or high-voltage power distribution systems.
Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes, including
requirements analysis, V-Model, architectural design, testing, and validation
.
Good understanding of the operating principles, types, and electrical/chemical characteristics of
lithium-ion cells
.
Ability to perform practical
energy, power, and electrical sizing calculations
.
Knowledge of communication protocols such as
CAN Bus, Modbus, Ethernet
, etc.
Experience with
system modeling and simulation tools
.
Knowledge of
MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461
, or relevant military battery safety and validation standards.
Good command of
English
, particularly for technical documentation and communication.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset.
Willingness to take an active role in field activities.
No restrictions on travel and ability to adapt to flexible working conditions.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on
energy storage system projects for land, naval, aerial, or unmanned platforms
.
Field experience in
FAT and SAT
processes.
Experience with
DFMEA/PFMEA and Root Cause Analysis
activities.
Knowledge of
battery safety standards and safe design solutions
.
Strong interest in and awareness of current
battery and energy storage technologies
.
Why Altınay?
At
Altınay Savunma Teknolojileri
, we offer the opportunity to work on projects shaping the future of defense technologies, at the intersection of
high technology, systems engineering, and advanced energy solutions
.
If you are looking to take technical responsibility in the development of battery and energy storage systems, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to
end-to-end product development processes in defense industry projects
, we would be pleased to welcome you to our team.
Location:
Istanbul / Pendik - Teknopark Istanbul
We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our team.
